notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Since I noticed some people have trouble with the controls I added the possibility to move a rock by pressing A or Mouse Left. It should be easier or more intuitive now to play around.

Let me know if you have more issues/feedback in the comments! :)

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content: A small update has been released which resolves a few bugs with the barrels/boxes causing unexpected death screen.
